reportable_concepts.note: 'reportable' excludes abstract header concepts and generic scaffolding nodes, which never carry a DB value by design. This is the number that actually matters for mapping completeness - the top-level unmapped/mapped_to_db counts include every concept in the footprint and will look far worse than reality on returns with many abstract headers.
